reviewed: (26.2, re-derived from the 26.2 sources and javap -p -c, not inherited; #32) Every handler the authors had now has a 26.2 home with 1.21.1's effect. renderClouds HEAD: clouds are a frame-graph pass whose lambda (lambda$addCloudsPass$0) asks LevelRenderState.customCloudsRenderer (null-checked) before CloudRenderer.render, so the skip cancels that lambda at HEAD (require = 1), which also covers a dimension drawing its own clouds; the inherited 26.1.2 CloudRendererMixin still gates CloudRenderer.render (its 26.2 signature is unchanged). renderEntity: the EntityRenderDispatcher.submit @Redirect in submitEntities sets the occlusion flag; 26.2 runs submitFeatures at the top of render(), before the frame graph is built, so the flag is final before the clouds pass executes. renderSky TAIL: AfterSky is posted only inside lambda$addSkyPass$0, which render() does not add when shouldRenderSky is false and addSkyPass does not add for lava/powder snow, doesMobEffectBlockSky or Skybox NONE, and it is posted even after a custom CustomSkyboxRenderer.renderSky returned true; so the skybox has its own pass on targets.main injected before addMainPass (its 26.2 descriptor takes the PreparedFrame and the model-view Matrix4fc; require = 1), sets render()'s terrainFog slice with RenderSystem.setShaderFog as the sky and main passes do, is skipped when the @ModifyExpressionValue on renderSky saw true, and GlobalSkyboxHook.passOwned makes the AfterSky handler stand down. render() multiplies the view matrix onto the model-view stack, which the helpers upload as ModelViewMat, so the skybox PoseStack starts from identity (the old mulPose(event.getModelViewMatrix()) turned it twice); under reverse-Z the pass meets a depth buffer cleared to 0.0 and the helpers' default compare is GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL, so it draws everywhere in the frustum without writing depth, as vanilla's depth-less sky pipelines do. extractVisibleEntities moved to LevelExtractor (LevelExtractorMixin keeps the frustum in net.eca.mv.CullingFrustum). renderLevel's HEAD/RETURN handlers target its 26.2 name render(...). Two handlers are new on 26.2 (#33): a flag around the submitFeatures call that net.eca.mv.SubmitPhase reads, because 26.2 submits before the clear pass.
